headline: 今日无新片，《时光代理人》双榜领跑
headlineEn: No New Films Today; Link Click Leads Both Charts
summary: 今日无新电影上映，本周仅1部新片；《时光代理人》领跑电影与剧集周榜，电影端《大师计划》《街头霸王》受关注，剧集端《水晶湖》《塔尔萨之王》《幻视任务》热度高，《猫鼬》待映。
summaryEn: No new movies released today, with only one new film this week; Link Click leads both weekly movie and TV charts, while The Master Plan and Street Fighter draw movie attention, and Crystal Lake, Tulsa King, and Vision Quest are hot on TV. Mongoose is upcoming.

industryHighlights.text: 《时光代理人》同时领跑本周电影与剧集热度榜。

industryHighlights.text: 《水晶湖》与《塔尔萨之王》今日电影、剧集双榜高热。
industryHighlights.en: Crystal Lake and Tulsa King are hot on both movie and TV charts today.

industryHighlights.text: 《幻视任务》持续位列本周电影与剧集趋势前列。
